use_cases: Triggers form submissions and user interactions across applications
Provides clickable navigation elements for routing
Executes calls to action in dashboards and interfaces
Enables destructive actions with variant styling
ai_summary: A flexible button component built with Radix UI Slot for polymorphic rendering and class-variance-authority for type-safe variant handling. Supports multiple visual variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes, with accessible focus states and disabled behavior.
